messages:
maria: quick sync — where are we on the attribute schema+latency tags for the token-cost attribution P0? need owners and any blockers before we cut the metrics PR by EOD.
kevin: i own the schema change and the event contract. PR is drafted but blocked on a mapping from runtime route -> billing_rate (david i think you had a mapping table?).
simone: FYI i started a small PR to add latency_ms + stage fields. link: https://github.com/redwood/instrumentation/pull/412 — needs review for field names.
david: yes kevin, i have a mapping but it's in the infra repo and still behind a feature flag. i can extract a lightweight mapping table if we want to avoid the flag for now.
maria: do that — we need a deterministic cost calc in the pipeline. if infra can't ship today, a separate static mapping in analytics repo is fine.
anya: Data team will validate sample events once the PR is up. can you add example events so we can run local ingest?
simone: adding example payload in the PR. example below:
```json
{
  "event": "token_cost_attribution",
  "request_id": "req_01F8X2Y3Z",
  "project_id": "proj-42",
  "model": "redwood-llama-3-13b",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "token_count": 342,
  "token_cost": 0.0085,
  "latency_ms": 213,
  "stage": "serve",
  "timestamp": "2026-05-12T14:22:33Z"
}
```
kevin: sounds good. question: should `stage` be enum [ingest, batch, serve, fallback] or free text? i prefer enum.
mar ia: enum is better for querying. add docs + a migration note (old events may have `service` field).
david: i'll publish a small JSON file with route->billing_rate today. will ping when it's uploaded.
opsbot: CI started for PR #412 — lint OK, unit tests running (:gear:).
kevin: blocker — needs a tiny CHANGELOG entry and confirmation from security that we're not logging any PII fields. simone can you add changelog and remove any user_text fields from the sample?
simone: will do. removing `prompt_text` from examples and adding changelog.
anya: once PR is merged i'll run the QA ingest against staging and report differences in attribution vs current pipeline. aim to surface >1% divergence before we flip.
maria: next steps: (1) kevin merge once mapping file available, (2) simone add changelog + docs, (3) david upload mapping, (4) anya validate and report. callout: keep latency_ms in ms integer for aggregation.
kevin: noted. i'll also add a unit test that fails if `latency_ms` is absent.
david: mapping uploaded: https://internal.redwood/s3/metrics/route_billing_2026-05-12.json — pinged infra to remove flag later.
simone: PR updated, changelog added, sample payload sanitized.
opsbot: CI passed for #412 — all checks green.
anya: started ingest on staging, initial delta in cost attribution ~0.7% (within threshold). will share full report by 1600PT.
maria: great — thanks all. if we keep green, let's aim to merge today and schedule a canary rollout tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
